name: HIPAA (US Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
description: Privacy and security obligations for protected health information (PHI).

rules.title: Administrative, physical & technical safeguards
rules.requirement: The document must describe administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that protect electronic protected health information (ePHI).

rules.title: Minimum necessary use & disclosure
rules.requirement: Uses and disclosures of PHI must be limited to the minimum necessary to accomplish the intended purpose.

rules.title: Business Associate Agreements
rules.requirement: There must be Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) in place with any third party that handles PHI on the covered entity's behalf.

rules.title: Breach notification
rules.requirement: There must be a process to notify affected individuals (and HHS) of a breach of unsecured PHI without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 days.

rules.title: Individual access & amendment rights
rules.requirement: The document must describe individuals' rights to access, inspect, obtain a copy of, and request amendment of their health records.

rules.title: Encryption of ePHI
rules.requirement: Electronic PHI should be encrypted at rest and in transit to render it unusable to unauthorized individuals.
